title: Project Structure
use_cases: Use when navigating the repository to locate business logic within the services directory
Configure when setting up the environment using Docker Compose for one-command deployment
Implement when extending the system with new MCP tools in the prose_mcp module
Use when identifying the entry point for frontend styles and vanilla JavaScript logic
content:
```
ghostwriter3000/
├── backend/
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── api/routes/      # 20 route modules
│   │   ├── models/          # Pydantic data models
│   │   ├── services/        # Business logic, LLM, memory, style
│   │   └── utils/           # Prompts, backup, file I/O
│   ├── prose_mcp/           # MCP wrapper (74 tools, 10 modules)
│   └── requirements.txt
├── frontend/
│   ├── css/styles.css       # Single stylesheet, CSS variables
│   ├── js/app.js            # Single JS file, no framework
│   └── index.html           # Single HTML file
├── data/                    # Demo data (characters, scenes, world)
├── docker/                  # Dockerfile
├── docker-compose.yml       # One-command deployment
├── Makefile                 # make run | make docker | make stop
└── .env.example             # Configuration template
```
